notes.title: The end of the main development phase.
notes.content:
At the moment, all the functions planned for the first stage of development are added to the game. In the next half year, the detected errors will be eliminated and minor improvements will be added.

    In the first quarter of 2020, an iOS version may be implemented.

    The current version of the game has already been added several improvements proposed by users at the development stage. We continue to listen carefully to the game community and note some tips and observations for ourselves. Please leave your opinion in the comments below this announcement or create a separate discussion to discuss possible improvements.

notes.title: Added hardcore mode - Experience
notes.content:
Now the promised mode Experience is available, which will not be easy to pass, it may not be possible. But if suddenly it is possible for someone, the winner will receive a special skin of the playing field. Also, when the achievement system becomes available, the player will be credited with an achievement, apparently the most difficult in this game ...

notes.title: Online Match with Friends
notes.content: We draw your attention to the fact that if you have an Android device at your disposal, it is possible to connect to Online Match created by a friend. Just download the free version of the game in the Play Market. The free version will not have all the functionality of the Full version, but it is great for a duel with loved ones, as well as a demo ...

notes.title: Soon updates...
notes.content:
Plans for April: add a system of achievements and a small hardcore campaign.
Plans for May: working with online multiplayer, adding a rating system and a free search for opponents.
After these updates will be a slight increase in the price of the game in the store.
We hope to make our game more interesting soon...

notes.title: English Version
notes.content: The day before was finished translating the current version of the game into English.
